1-HOUR LIVE WATCH + FIX REPORT (SLS(115)->SLS(116)/10.30, WARRANT#134)

Watched a full calibration + start of a retry cycle live for 61 min (9 regimes through P3B, PBO-CSCV/bracket-fallback firing correctly, ghost landed 29.2% WR/24 trades -> triggered retry). Zero real trades opened.

FIXED (WARRANT#134): Phase 4's 25/50/75% progress was Print()-only -- invisible to the real-time log, directly explaining an observed ~12min silent gap (18:34-18:46). Same defect class as WARRANT#20/120/121/125/130. Also added a Sleep(1) yield -- this was the one major long scan loop never covered by WARRANT#31/#103's hang-fix sweeps. Fixed both, compiled 0 errors, deployed to all 3 locations.

CONFIRMED BUT DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED: Phase 3B's grid stages (scan-wide/mid/fine) are 100% deterministic (verified via a full-file MathRand grep -- only Stage 6 and one later refinement stage use randomization). Live proof: r1's grid-stage numbers were byte-identical across both pipeline attempts this run. Every full-pipeline retry (up to 3x) re-derives already-known-identical numbers across all 9 regimes for zero new information except Stage 6. Real, high-value lever -- did NOT chase the exact retry re-entry point far enough to safely wire a skip without risking Stage 6's incumbent state, so left as a scoped, evidenced lead for a dedicated pass rather than rushing a fix into live weight-search logic.

GENESIS / AWAKEN-HARDENED-FORGE (ran in tandem, separate codebase, strategies x): Historian (M2) build-order-first per CONCERN-04. All 3 named M2 organs now exist and compile clean: HIST_Sweep (fold-construction, leakage/survivorship guards, the red-team null-data + planted-in-sample-edge acceptance tests), HIST_Cartographer (persisted flip-aware edge map, 14-day confidence half-life), HIST_FamilyGen (out-of-family validation, quarantines a family that "only fits itself"). 19 new tests total, zero regression across 29 test files. Honest state: this is real construction progress on M2, not a working alpha yet -- still needs a real live-history data bridge, then M1 (orchestrator loop), then M3-M6, each its own dedicated pass. GENESIS_LEDGER.json at pass_11.

forge_ledger.json at pass_104. Both ledgers, source, and compiled ex4 attached.
